headline: Your BeCause waterfall journey.
subheadline: A scrollable GTMx strategy artifact for routing hotels, hotel groups, destinations, and travel partners into the right BeCause certification, framework-mapping, CSRD, or open-data offer. List building, campaign angles, and sample copy, prepared for Asam Nawaz, Head of Sales.
productSummary: BeCause (because.eco) is sustainability and ESG data-management software built for travel, tourism, and hospitality. Homepage positioning: enabling certification support, data management, ESG compliance, and open data sharing for businesses in hospitality, tourism, and travel. Core capabilities published on because.eco: 60+ tourism frameworks mapped so data is entered once; Certification Co-pilot to steer hotels toward a fit certification; ESRS tool for CSRD/ESG compliance; Applications Manager for supplier sustainability and corporate-travel buyer submissions; a data hub for consolidating and sharing sustainability data with OTAs, certifiers, destinations, and travel partners; hotel utility trackers and industry-framework integrations. Buyer segments on site: hospitality providers (hotels, restaurants, attractions, events), travel marketplaces and OTAs, and destinations/partners. Public proof language includes Radisson Hotel Group (Sven Wiltink, Global Senior Director Sustainability), VisitEngland, GDS-Index destinations, and Vera-FY (a WSHA initiative powered by BeCause). Framework/certification partners and schemes listed on the hospitality solution page include Green Key, Travelife, GSTC-aligned certifiers, EarthCheck, GreenSign, Nordic Swan, Booking.com/Travalyst-linked schemes, ISO 14001/50001, LEED, and dozens more. Asam Nawaz is Head of Sales (asam@because.eco).
coreInsight: Asam sells one BeCause sustainability data hub for travel & hospitality — not a different product per hotel brand or country. Hotel chain vs independent, OTA vs DMO, and region are merge tags after routing, not a second waterfall. The single routing signal is sustainability_maturity: what a lead source can already see on the property/company site and travel directories — competing hospitality ESG platform, public eco-certification (or Travel Sustainable badge) without a platform, sustainability/ESG page (or Sustainability title) without a cert, or none. That ladder maps to BeCause's live offers: competitor switch + consolidation, certification/framework mapping, Certification Co-pilot + CSRD prep, then a soft remaining-TAM sustainability data playbook.

sections.label: Signal
sections.title: The signal is how far their sustainability stack already shows up publicly
sections.takeaway: Hotel sites, Booking.com Travel Sustainable badges, certification logos, and careers already show a competing ESG platform, a public eco-cert, a sustainability page/title, or none. That sustainability_maturity is stronger than a title guess and cheap to collect.

sections.label: Waterfall
sections.title: One cascade routes every in-TAM travel & hospitality account
sections.takeaway: First match wins. Competing ESG platform first, then certified-without-platform, then sustainability-page-without-cert, then every remaining hotel, group, destination, and travel partner in TAM.

sections.label: Tiers
sections.title: Each maturity band gets a different first offer
sections.takeaway: Competitor platforms get a Switch + Consolidation Brief. Certified properties get a Framework Mapping Brief. Sustainability-page accounts get the Certification Co-pilot Brief. The rest get the BeCause Sustainability Data Playbook.

sections.label: Campaigns
sections.title: Switch the hub, map the frameworks, get certified, then cover the rest
sections.takeaway: The list is always travel/hospitality accounts BeCause sells into. Segment (hotel group vs independent vs OTA vs DMO) and region are merge tags. A/Bs sit on exclusive routes (duplicate-reporting pain vs CSRD audit-readiness).

sections.label: Email Copy
sections.title: Copy that names the sustainability signal already visible on their site
sections.takeaway: Notice the platform, cert badge, or sustainability page, poke the duplicate-reporting / certification / CSRD gap that state implies, then ask for a one-letter yes.

sections.label: Launch
sections.title: Launch the competitor-platform switch route first
sections.takeaway: Start where sustainability_maturity already shows Ecostars, Con-Serve, Sustainwize, GreenTurGo, or similar. Prove reply density, then roll certified-without-platform, Certification Co-pilot, and the remaining-TAM catch-all.

signalReasons: Apollo / LinkedIn Sales Nav + hospitality directories (hotel groups, independents, attractions, DMOs, OTAs/travel marketplaces) are the TAM BeCause already sells into. Public global TAM account count is not published on because.eco; treat size as estimated (see because-magnet-flags.txt) and keep each launch tier >=~1,500 contacts where possible.

The same site + directory scrape returns sustainability_maturity: competing hospitality ESG/sustainability platforms (Ecostars, Con-Serve/Considerate, Sustainwize, GreenTurGo, adjacent); public eco-certifications or Travel Sustainable badges (Green Key, Travelife, GSTC-aligned, EarthCheck, GreenSign, Nordic Swan, Booking.com/Travalyst-linked); sustainability/ESG page or Head of Sustainability title without a cert; or none — enough to route without a second expensive enrichment product.

The ladder maps to live BeCause positioning (Certification Co-pilot, 60+ framework mapping with no duplicate entry, CSRD/ESRS tool, Applications Manager, open data sharing with OTAs and travel partners) plus public proof language (Radisson Hotel Group, VisitEngland, GDS-Index, Vera-FY / WSHA).

Segment (hotel group vs independent vs OTA vs DMO), region, and buyer title (Head of Sustainability / ESG / Ops / GM) are scrape filters and merge tags, not a second waterfall. Apollo is email last after the account is routed.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND sustainability_maturity = competitor_platform (Ecostars, Con-Serve/Considerate, Sustainwize, GreenTurGo, or adjacent hospitality ESG data hub) AND not already_customer
routingRules.why: They already budget a hospitality ESG/sustainability platform. Strongest switch intent for BeCause as the travel-native data hub with 60+ framework mapping and open sharing to OTAs/partners.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND sustainability_maturity = certified_no_platform (public Green Key / Travelife / GSTC-aligned / EarthCheck / GreenSign / Nordic Swan / Booking.com Travel Sustainable / similar) AND no Tier-1 competitor_platform AND not already_customer
routingRules.why: They already carry a public eco-cert or Travel Sustainable badge but no competing hub — classic duplicate-reporting pain across frameworks, RFPs, and OTAs. Maps to BeCause enter-once / map-everywhere.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND sustainability_maturity = sustainability_page_no_cert (sustainability/ESG/CR page OR Head of Sustainability / ESG title) AND no Tier 1-2 AND not already_customer
routingRules.why: They signal intent publicly but have not landed a cert yet. Maps to BeCause Certification Co-pilot + CSRD/ESRS prep without inventing a cert they do not have.

routingRules.if: in_tam AND none of the above
routingRules.why: Still in TAM (hotels, groups, destinations, travel partners). Softest CTA around consolidating sustainability data, certifications, and partner sharing. Mandatory 100% coverage.

tiers.name: Tier 1
tiers.label: Competing hospitality ESG platform detected
tiers.trigger: sustainability_maturity = competitor_platform (Ecostars, Con-Serve/Considerate, Sustainwize, GreenTurGo, adjacent); in-TAM travel/hospitality account; not already a BeCause customer
tiers.pain: They are already paying for a hospitality ESG/sustainability stack and still re-enter the same data for certifications, OTA badges, corporate RFPs, and CSRD — lock-in plus duplicate reporting.
tiers.valueProp: Competitor Switch + Consolidation Brief: BeCause as the travel-native hub — 60+ frameworks mapped once, Certification Co-pilot, open sharing to OTAs/partners, CSRD/ESRS path.
tiers.dataSource: Site/partner-logo scrape + optional BuiltWith for Ecostars / Con-Serve / Sustainwize / GreenTurGo
tiers.replyDensity: Highest - they already budget hospitality ESG software
tiers.accounts: est. flagged; not published on because.eco — keep each tier >=~1,500 contacts before launch when the TAM allows

tiers.name: Tier 2
tiers.label: Public eco-cert / Travel Sustainable, no platform
tiers.trigger: sustainability_maturity = certified_no_platform (Green Key, Travelife, GSTC-aligned, EarthCheck, GreenSign, Nordic Swan, Booking.com Travel Sustainable, similar); no Tier-1 competitor_platform
tiers.pain: A public cert or Travel Sustainable badge usually means spreadsheets and emails every time a new framework, OTA, or corporate travel buyer asks for the same evidence again.
tiers.valueProp: Framework Mapping Brief: enter sustainability data once in BeCause and populate 60+ tourism frameworks plus partner/OTA sharing — named proof framing via Radisson / VisitEngland-style data-hub language on because.eco.
tiers.dataSource: Certification directories + Booking.com/OTA Travel Sustainable badges + site cert logos
tiers.replyDensity: High - visible cert, clear duplicate-reporting pain

tiers.name: Tier 3
tiers.label: Sustainability page / ESG title, no cert yet
tiers.trigger: sustainability_maturity = sustainability_page_no_cert (sustainability/ESG/CR page OR Head of Sustainability / ESG / CSR title) with no Tier 1-2 match
tiers.pain: Public sustainability intent without a cert usually means the team is stuck choosing a scheme, collecting evidence, and worrying about CSRD — slow, manual, and easy to greenwash-accuse.
tiers.valueProp: Certification Co-pilot Brief: BeCause steers the right certification path, consolidates evidence, and maps collected data toward ESRS/CSRD when relevant.
tiers.dataSource: Site sustainability/ESG page scrape + LinkedIn title signals
tiers.replyDensity: Medium - clear intent, longer education cycle

tiers.name: Catch-all
tiers.label: Remaining in-TAM travel & hospitality accounts
tiers.trigger: in_tam hotel / hotel group / attraction / DMO / OTA / travel marketplace with buyer Sustainability/ESG/Ops/GM and no Tier 1-3 sustainability_maturity match
tiers.pain: Most travel & hospitality operators know sustainability data, certifications, and partner sharing are coming — but have not publicly exposed a platform, cert, or ESG page yet, so the work still lives in spreadsheets.
tiers.valueProp: Soft BeCause Sustainability Data Playbook: practical paths into certification support, framework mapping, CSRD prep, and open data sharing with travel partners — soft CTA, site proof of Radisson / VisitEngland / GDS-Index language.
tiers.dataSource: Apollo / Sales Nav hospitality-travel TAM after in_tam gate
tiers.accounts: est. flagged; catch-all must cover remaining TAM
